seo.title: Careers at Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital, Kochi
seo.description: Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital (IGCH), a multispeciality hospital in Kadavanthra, Kochi, welcomes applications from qualified and experienced professionals looking for hospital jobs in Kochi.

hero.lead: Make a difference through the work you do.

openings.heading: Open positions
openings.emptyText: We are not hiring for specific roles at the moment, but we keep good applications on file. Send us your CV and we will be in touch when a suitable role opens.

cv.heading: Find your place in our healthcare team.
cv.text: Whether you are looking for a current vacancy or wish to be considered for future openings, you can share your resume with our HR team.
cv.fallbackText: Call us on {phone} to ask about openings.

paragraphs: Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital (IGCH), a multispeciality hospital in Kadavanthra, Kochi, brings together medical professionals, nurses, technicians and administrative staff across various departments.
We welcome applications from qualified and experienced professionals interested in exploring career opportunities at our hospital.
We welcome applications from qualified and experienced professionals looking for hospital jobs in Kochi and interested in joining our team.
